probe_1_seen_virgin7.hypothesis: Isolates whether the seen-seller component of D1 provides positive net fixes on public LB.

decision_rule.if_positive (> .94633): Confirms seen-seller flips are active. Retain D1 and expand seen-seller high-margin set.
decision_rule.if_neutral_or_negative (<= .94633): Seen flips provide no lift or negative lift. Focus entirely on new-seller inductive features.

probe_2_new_virgin16.hypothesis: Isolates whether the new-seller component of D2 is the true source of gain in D1+D2 (.94652).

decision_rule.if_positive (> .94633): Confirms new-seller inductive signals drive LB gains. Habilita candidate expansions on new sellers.
decision_rule.if_neutral_or_negative (<= .94633): Indicates new-seller threshold was overly aggressive. Re-calibrate toward conservative threshold.

probe_3_reverse_polarity_virgin12.hypothesis: Evaluates whether high-confidence model flips in the opposite direction (new -> used) recover ground truth without asymmetric penalty.

decision_rule.if_positive (> .94633): Validates bidirectional error correction. Incorporate P3 into 5th submission.
decision_rule.if_neutral_or_negative (<= .94633): Confirms strong asymmetric penalty for false used. Restrict candidate flips strictly to used -> new.

probe_4_inductive_price_extreme15.hypothesis: Tests whether category-relative price percentiles provide robust inductive discriminative signal on new sellers.

decision_rule.if_positive (> .94633): Validates inductive relative price features on new sellers. Merge P4 into 5th candidate.
decision_rule.if_neutral_or_negative (<= .94633): Discards extreme price percentile heuristic. Rely on full tree model ranking.
